claim_boundary: Exact ray-character hand calculation, norm identity, and conditional epsilon bookkeeping only; no Hecke-family large-value or density theorem follows.

derivation: Both sides are multiplicative by unique ideal factorization and divisor convolution.
p=2: one ideal of norm 2^e and sum_{j=0}^e chi_-4(2)^j=1.
p=1 mod 4: p=ppbar, so e+1 ideals of norm p^e and sum_{j=0}^e 1=e+1.
p=3 mod 4: p is a prime ideal of norm p^2, so there is one ideal for even e and none for odd e; sum_{j=0}^e(-1)^j has exactly that value.
norm_aggregation.inequality: 0<=a_Q(i)(n)<=tau(n), because chi_-4(d) is in {-1,0,1} and the local formulas are nonnegative.

normalization.epsilon_lemma: For each delta>0, D_N<<_delta N^delta. If N<=T^C for fixed C, then D_N^4<<_{delta,C}T^(4C delta)=T^o(1); choose delta after the desired o(1) allowance. Hence all three multipliers are absorbed into the existing T^o(1).
normalization.exact_threshold_substitution: V becomes V/D_N, yielding multipliers D_N^2, D_N^4, D_N^4 on the three Theorem-1.1 terms.
normalization.gm_proof_regime: The pinned proof explicitly reduces the nontrivial use of Theorem 1.1 to N<T, which is covered with C=1.
normalization.normalization: D_N=max_{N<n<=2N} tau(n); b_n=A_chi(n)/D_N has |b_n|<=1 and F_chi=D_N F_b.
normalization.separate_family_cost: Even in N<=T^C this only normalizes each fixed chi polynomial. It does not supply a common coefficient vector or pay the cost of summing over chi.

stated_estimate.height_length_condition_for_absorption: N<=T^C for a fixed C; the GM proof's nontrivial reduction uses N<T

normalization.unconditional_limit: NOT_ESTABLISHED for an arbitrary two-parameter use of the displayed theorem with no relation between N and T: N^o(1) need not be T^o(1).

ray_character_calculation.class_number_one_reduction: For h(Q(i))=1, a coprime ideal (alpha) is evaluated through alpha modulo f, modulo the generator ambiguity mu_4.

mod_3.exact_conductor: The only proper divisor of (3) is (1); its ray quotient is trivial.

pi_power.exact_conductor: The nontrivial e=4 quotient character cannot factor through e<4 because all those quotients are trivial.
